name: Vector tween animation
summary: A vector shape moves, changes size or fades between two key frames, and the tool fills the frames between them.
how: Set a key frame at the start and at the end, 12 to 24 frames apart.
Set the easing to ease-out for entrances, with a curve of 400ms to 800ms.
Keep the movement to 40px to 120px per scene.
Add a sound cue at the end of the move.

origin.note: FutureSplash Animator added vector tweens for the web; Macromedia later renamed it Flash.

adoptions.via: Agencies build full sites as Flash timelines with intros and animated menus.
